# StippleText

Text that prints itself: each character arrives as a scatter of dots on a 3 × 4 grid, then resolves, left to right.

`SparkInternals.StippleText` · Labels

## Use

```jsx
<SparkInternals.StippleText text="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SparkInternals.StippleText" text="…"></x-import>
```
